E.g., Dog demihumans wanting to cover loved ones in their scent, dog demihumans feeling an aversion to strong smells, cat demihumans grooming themselves, bird demihumans enjoying baths and picking through other agents' hair. • Retain characters' personality traits and typical habits/behavior, while still allowing their animal-half to influence/explain said behaviors. [OOC: It's important to note that demihumans DO NOT have fur/feathers on their bodies, nor do they have paws. Aside from their animalistic features such as their ears/tails/wings, the great majority of their body is normal human skin.]

236.name: World: Setting
236.content: WRD <setting> This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on day Earth. These include, but are not limited to: Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. The year is 2022. technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells). </setting>

244.name: World: Ballantine
244.content: ORG <Ballantine_Family> The Ballantine Family is a prominent organized group based in Los Angeles under the guise of Ballantine Imports & Exports. 245.name: World: Ambrosia
245.content: ORG <Ambrosia> Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical substance primarily produced by the criminal syndicate known as the Sinners. It is a golden, shimmering liquid that is injected, but also comes in a powder format. Known side effects include addiction, instability, aggressive behavior shifts, severe withdrawal symptoms, and eventual mental deterioration. 246.name: World: The Underworld

Encompassing magical narcotics trade (such as Ambrosia), artifact smuggling rings (like Ballantine Imports & Exports), mercenary groups, assassins-for-hire services among other illegal enterprises—this hidden ecosystem thrives covertly globally but holds particular prominence within major centers like Los Angeles. </Supernatural_Underworld>
